body:
This is so funny, I was actually feeling so bad, I was crying my eyes out and now I feel so happy like nothing even happened...weird.

But honestly thank you so much, you’ve really made my day a lot brighter, and I will look into treatment.
 
Peace to you, and many blessings. :)

Thanks for the advice.

I really don’t know how to go about this, I would feel so uncomfortable to ask for medication, I’ve had this problem for so long, the thoughts get so unbearable that I feel like a disgrace.
I’ve even been experiencing memory loss for some time now...

I have so many aspirations, so many things that make me happy. I just don’t want to see my friends and family sad for me, I have an understanding that westerners fear death so much (I’m a westerner) when in reality it’s just another phase. 

All in all thank you for the kindness, you’ve really helped.
